raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

External linker lookups cannot currently report pending separately from a completed miss. This lets an asynchronous lookup fall through to recomputation unless a backend blocks or patches private admission internals.

Refs https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/issues/44872.

## Modifications

- Accept `None` for pending lookup and propagate `cache_lookup_pending` through the actual match result and request. Skip pending requests before PrefillAdder capacity checks, budgets, locks and loads; ready siblings remain eligible.
- Reuse slot zero of the existing sparse-boundary MIN mask for readiness. Every rank participates before deciding pending versus a terminal result; no additional collective. Cancel a miss only after all ranks are ready.
- Add a default no-op lookup-only cancellation callback for synchronous backends. Retire superseded queries/markers at native abort, session/disabled bypass, full HBM and unusable tails. Cancellation errors still preserve the existing queued/started-load cleanup responsibility.
- Update the native Scheduler LoRA set only for actually appended requests. A deferred adapter cannot block a ready sibling when max_loras_per_batch=1; an admitted adapter still occupies its slot.
- Require stable terminal results and an original finite deadline across rematches. Keep timeout/input validation and stale callback fencing in the async backend. No new payload-transfer lifecycle or default backend change.

## Accuracy Tests

165 CPU tests and 66 subtests pass; 16 CUDA-fixture cases explicitly skip. This covers actual candidate-source matching, native prefill and abort methods with local backend/allreduce collaborators, including pending/miss/hit rank combinations, changed keys, repeated polls, HBM/session bypass, force-miss and cancellation errors. Baseline controls detect pending and premature-admission gaps. All 3,722 pre-existing installed SGLang Python files remain unchanged; CUDA stays uninitialized.

```bash
export PYTHONPATH="$PWD/python"
export PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1
export CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=999999
export FLASHINFER_WORKSPACE_BASE=/tmp/sglang-pending-admission-cache
python -B -m pytest -q --no-showlocals --tb=short \
  test/registered/unit/mem_cache/test_unified_cache_linker.py \
  test/registered/unit/mem_cache/test_prefill_memory_budget.py \
  test/registered/unit/mem_cache/test_radix_force_miss.py \
  test/registered/unit/managers/test_schedule_policy.py \
  test/registered/unit/managers/test_schedule_policy_dfs_weight.py \
  test/registered/unit/mem_cache/test_unified_hicache_transfer_lifecycle.py \
  test/registered/unit/managers/test_prefill_adder.py \
  test/registered/unit/managers/test_scheduler_held_row_admission.py
```

Source base: `bce7b27aa6aabda681351f8f4c20776981b5d5d4`. Genuine dependencies: Python 3.11.10, PyTorch 2.13.0, sglang-kernel 0.4.7, FlashInfer 0.6.18, NumPy 2.2.6, pytest 9.1.1. The checkout supplies SGLang modules via PYTHONPATH; the borrowed environment's installed distribution metadata is 0.5.20. Scheduler capacity/preemption checks retain their existing order before rematching; the no-budget/lock/load mutation guarantee is local to PrefillAdder. The real caller/LoRA-manager CPU control passes on this candidate and fails the old parent for the deferred-request case, while its admitted-request capacity control passes. This is source CPU testing, not installed 0.5.21 or GPU qualification. No runtime-module replacements are used. GPU/model output, physical multi-rank collectives/failures, live DMA cancellation/page reuse and released adoption remain untested; keeping this draft for contract discussion and those gates.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

No performance claim, kernel change or inference benchmark. The existing reduction gains a readiness bit without adding a collective.

## Checklist

- [x] Changed files pass pinned isort 7.0.0 and Ruff 0.15.1.
- [x] Extend existing registered CPU suites.
- [x] Document pending/cancellation ownership in the public interface.
- [ ] GPU/model and physical multi-rank validation.

+def test_async_lookup_rematch_adopts_only_the_current_result(async_lookup_cache):

+def test_same_rid_changed_keys_replace_the_old_match(async_lookup_cache):

+    req = SimpleNamespace(rid="query")
